messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Tell your healthcare provider about any mental problems you or your child have, or about a family history of suicide, bipolar illness, or depression.
Call your healthcare provider right away if you or your child have any new or worsening mental symptoms during treatment.
This is especially important if you experience hearing voices.
It is also important if you see or believe things that are not real.
It is also important if you have new manic symptoms.
Circulation problems:
You may have blood circulation problems that can cause numbness, pain, or discoloration in your fingers or toes.
Call your doctor right away if you have unexplained wounds appearing on your fingers or toes during treatment.
Other warnings:
Do not use Adderall if you have used an MAO inhibitor in the past 14 days.
Examples of MAO inhibitors include isocarboxazid, linezolid, phenelzine, rasagiline, selegiline, and tranylcypromine.
Do not use Adderall if you have received a methylene blue injection.
A dangerous drug interaction could occur.
You may not be able to use Adderall if you have glaucoma.
Triples: [["Adderall", "has administration instruction", "tell healthcare provider about mental problems or family history of suicide, bipolar illness, or depression"], ["Adderall", "has administration instruction", "call healthcare provider right away if new or worsening mental symptoms during treatment"], ["Adderall", "has administration instruction", "call healthcare provider if hearing voices"], ["Adderall", "has administration instruction", "call healthcare provider if seeing or believing things that are not real"], ["Adderall", "has administration instruction", "call healthcare provider if new manic symptoms"], ["Adderall", "has side effect", "blood circulation problems"], ["Adderall", "has side effect", "numbness in fingers or toes"], ["Adderall", "has side effect", "pain in fingers or toes"], ["Adderall", "has side effect", "discoloration in fingers or toes"], ["Adderall", "has administration instruction", "call doctor right away if unexplained wounds on fingers or toes during treatment"], ["Adderall", "contraindicated in", "use of MAO inhibitor in past 14 days"], ["Adderall", "interacts with", "MAO inhibitors"], ["MAO inhibitors", "includes", "isocarboxazid"], ["MAO inhibitors", "includes", "linezolid"], ["MAO inhibitors", "includes", "phenelzine"], ["MAO inhibitors", "includes", "rasagiline"], ["MAO inhibitors", "includes", "selegiline"], ["MAO inhibitors", "includes", "tranylcypromine"], ["Adderall", "contraindicated in", "methylene blue injection"], ["Adderall", "has warning", "dangerous drug interaction"], ["Adderall", "has contraindication", "glaucoma"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "has administration instruction", "has contraindication", "has side effect", "has warning", "includes", "interacts with"]
Answer:

completion:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have used or are using the substance or condition specified by the object entity.  
has administration instruction: The subject drug requires the specific action or communication with healthcare providers described by the object entity during its use.  
has contraindication: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.  
has side effect: The subject drug may cause the adverse physical or physiological effect specified by the object entity.  
has warning: The subject drug is associated with the specific risk or caution described by the object entity.  
includes: The subject category or class contains the specific item or member specified by the object entity.  
interacts with: The subject drug may have a harmful or dangerous interaction with the substance or medication specified by the object entity.
